summary: ADR-0048 Accepted 2026-07-26; source and Accepted ADRs are fact authority; projections/indexes are derived_cache; deterministic Locator returns locations, hashes, provenance, ranking evidence, confidence, never synthesized facts; callers reread and hash-verify; trusted adapters constrain domain/path/snapshot/budget/confidence; LLM intent cannot widen envelope; VDD records accept/reject after reread, rejected or uncovered required modules block readiness; Quick Dev uses VDD-frozen accepted decisions; Bootstrap Review freezes accepted context in Artifact View; no post-freeze expansion; ambiguity fallback default disabled, approved Python fallback only via scripts/sc/_llm_backend.py::run_llm_exec; maintenance pins local refs/heads/main, performs no implicit fetch/checkout/merge/branch mutation, records derived artifacts and append-only evidence; failures fail closed on missing/stale/low-confidence/out-of-policy/hash drift; extends ADR-0044; complements, does not supersede ADR-0037/0041/0043; authorizes no phase routes, Hosted E2 changes, live metadata, deployment, acceptance, handoff, release, or commit.
